selection_reason: User-requested normalization comparison: retain k=3 and replace only the standalone word denominator by literal paper Equation 7 sequence length. Reuse saved iLearn-normalized k3_full control.
tuning: None: one fixed reported S1 candidate per base, fixed CatBoost meta-model, no variant selection
primary_summary: Pooled held-out accuracy at threshold 0.5; all 2968 training records held out exactly once
secondary_summaries: Pooled AUROC (scores from separately fitted models; no pooled calibration implied)
Pooled MCC, sensitivity, specificity and confusion matrix
Individual base predictions as descriptive diagnostics; no model selection

reference.purpose: Matched descriptive comparison with the earlier reconstructed iEnhancer-2L binary SVM
reference.not_a_controlled_algorithm_comparison: The feature sets and parameter-selection procedures differ; these folds have already informed exploratory analyses.

uncertainty.method: Paired cluster bootstrap: resample sequence/locus groups with replacement within each outer fold, retaining all rows of each selected group; use the same draws for both models
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles for pooled MCSE accuracy and MCSE-minus-reference accuracy
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on these fitted predictions; does not include model refitting, source-parameter selection or prior exploratory choices

failure_policy: Stop on nonconvergence or invalid probabilities; retain failure evidence and do not publish partial aggregate metrics
limits: Exploratory follow-up after viewing prior benchmark results; not fresh independent confirmation.
This tests only the standalone 3-mer frequency denominator, not every normalization in the paper or other descriptor blocks.
All sequences have length 200: count/L is 0.99 times count/(L-2), with unchanged information and dimensionality.
Feature-family mapping, final ensemble choices and historical software remain unresolved; this is a repaired reconstruction, not exact reproduction.
Reported S1 settings may already have been selected using these labels.
Intervals condition on fitted predictions; no refitting, seed variation or parameter-selection uncertainty.
No historical contaminated test records or NEW_2026_DATA outcomes are used; no winning model is selected.
publication: Local only; no commit or push
